exposure: admission to US juvenile residential systems (JRS)
Incarceration in a juvenile residential system (JRS)
outcome: Number of pregnant admissions to JRS
Pregnancy outcomes (live births, miscarriages, induced abortions, ectopic pregnancies, maternal deaths, newborn deaths)
JRS administrative policies related to pregnancy
cohort: Pregnant adolescents admitted to 3 non-randomly selected juvenile residential systems (JRS) in 3 US states
finding: This study found that among pregnant adolescents in JRS, most returned to their communities while still pregnant, highlighting the importance of continuity of care.
